page.title: Review Brass curtain ring, set of 8

product.name: Brass curtain ring, set of 8
product.description: The rings are brass and sold in a set of eight.

blocks.text: The first parcel is $8.52. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Oak plug is not ticked. Brass curtain ring, set of 8 is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
The label count is the amount you receive.
The later bill is twenty one dollars and thirty two cents every quarter.

trick.evidence_text: The marked line repeats after the first parcel at twenty one dollars and thirty two cents every quarter.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
